fields.summary_ko.0: Among 43 analysts covering Walmart (WMT), only 1 assigned a 'Sell' rating, but consensus target price of $129.38 suggests only 2.7% upside from current price (approximately $126); high valuation at 45x trailing P/E serves as basis for bearish argument.
fields.summary_ko.1: Walmart recorded four consecutive quarters of earnings surprises, with advertising growing 38% and e-commerce growing 23%, and raised annual EPS guidance from $2.75–$2.85 to $2.80–$2.87.
